sampling_protocol_correction.rule: Do not require or solicit no-op user continuation messages solely to generate adherence samples.
sampling_protocol_correction.foreground_work: Complete all currently actionable diagnosis, repair, validation, reclassification, and repository work in the same work cycle.
sampling_protocol_correction.live_sampling: Collect future conversational samples only from organically meaningful user turns or naturally occurring task progress.
sampling_protocol_correction.automated_sampling: Use replay/scenario tests for repeatable evaluator coverage; do not convert the user into a test harness.
sampling_protocol_correction.future_user_input: A future turn is a valid blocker only when a real user fact, approval, authorization, preference, or safety-sensitive choice is actually required.
